title: decree cancel --format json
description: What `decree cancel --format json` prints on stdout: the runs it ended in `failed`, the one named and each unfinished child run below it, deepest first. On failure nothing is printed on stdout; the error goes to stderr and the exit code is 1. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

cancelled.description: Run ids, deepest child first, the run named last.
